title: core/coating
description: Data describing the insulating coating applied to a magnetic core

type.description: The type of coating material applied to the core
type.title: coatingType

thickness.description: Thickness of the coating, in m. A dimensionWithTolerance, because sources usually bound it rather than state a nominal (e.g. a 0.6 mm maximum, or a minimum per ring size), so give only the bounds that are known. A thickness of 0 means the core is bare: a coating object with zero thickness records that the core was checked and has no coating.

material.description: Material of the coating, providing its relative permittivity and dielectric strength
material.title: InsulationMaterialDataOrNameUnion

oneOf.description: The name of the material used in the insulation
